parrafo_1.es: Macon Electric LLC es un negocio local de Tallahassee, FL. El que responde el mensaje es el mismo que llega a hacer el trabajo: sin centrales telefónicas ni intermediarios.
parrafo_1.en: Macon Electric LLC is a local Tallahassee, FL business. Whoever answers your message is who shows up to do the work: no call centers, no middlemen.

parrafo_2.es: Una reseña en Google lo resume bien: un árbol dejó caer una rama sobre el cable de servicio de una propiedad en alquiler, y la dueña escribió que "James tuvo todo arreglado rápido, y fue muy proactivo con la comunicación. Trabajo bien hecho." Esa misma respuesta se repite, ya sea una luz que falla o una emergencia de fin de semana.
parrafo_2.en: One Google review sums it up well: a tree limb fell on the service power wire at a rental property, and the owner wrote that "James had it fixed quickly, and was very proactive about communication. Job well done." That same response shows up call after call, whether it is a flickering switch or a weekend emergency.

items.quote: James Macon and his team did an excellent job at installing electricity to my shed/office. They were responsive and went above and beyond to get this projected completed within my timeframe. I will definitely use them again.
James was quick to respond to our emergency! A tree limb fell on the service power wire at my rental property. James had it fixed quickly, and was very proactive about communication. Job well done.
James is a very reliable, skilled, and polite electrician. He trouble shooted a problem with my bathroom light and was able to fix, replace it. I highly recommend Macon Electric!
